t: Two graves and two small things
a: إِنَّهُمَا لَيُعَذَّبَانِ، وَمَا يُعَذَّبَانِ فِي كَبِيرٍ، أَمَّا هَذَا فَكَانَ لاَ يَسْتَتِرُ مِنْ بَوْلِهِ، وَأَمَّا هَذَا فَكَانَ يَمْشِي بِالنَّمِيمَةِ
p: Innahumā la-yuʿadhdhabān, wa mā yuʿadhdhabāni fī kabīr. Ammā hādhā fa-kāna lā yastatiru min bawlih, wa ammā hādhā fa-kāna yamshī bi-n-namīmah
m: They are being punished, and they are not being punished for something major. This one did not keep himself clean of his urine, and this one used to walk about carrying tales.
